description: This is a PHP class file that implements relationship handling for writing XLSX files in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for generating XML relationship data for workbook, worksheet, drawing, chart, and other parts of an Excel document.

classes.name: Rels
classes.description: This class manages the creation of XML relationships for parts of an XLSX document, including workbook, worksheets, drawings, charts, and other related elements. It extends from WriterPart and provides specific methods for writing relationship data in XML format.

methods.name: writeRelationships
methods.description: Generates XML for overall relationships of the spreadsheet, including core properties, custom properties, app.xml, workbook.xml, and optional ribbon.xml data.

methods.name: writeWorkbookRelationships
methods.description: Creates the relationship XML for the workbook, including styles, theme, shared strings, and sheets, plus optional VBA project.

methods.name: writeWorksheetRelationships
methods.description: Constructs relationships XML for individual worksheets, including drawings, hyperlinks, comments, tables, header/footer images, and unparsed data.

methods.name: writeDrawingRelationships
methods.description: Creates relationships for drawings and charts in a worksheet, including images and chart files.

methods.name: writeHeaderFooterDrawingRelationships
methods.description: Creates relationships specifically for header/footer images.

methods.name: writeVMLDrawingRelationships
methods.description: Creates relationships for VML drawings, used for comments and background images.

methods.name: writeRelationship
methods.description: Private helper method to write individual <Relationship> XML elements with given ID, type, target, and target mode.

methods.name: writeUnparsedRelationship
methods.description: Helper method to write relationships that are stored in unparsed loaded data for sheets, such as background images.

methods.name: writeHyperlinkRelationship
methods.description: Writes a relationship for an external hyperlink within a worksheet.

methods.name: writeDrawingHyperLink
methods.description: Helper for writing relationships for drawing hyperlinks, updating the relationship ID accordingly.
